title: Accounting Supervisor
description:
Be part of a new era in communications, transforming connectivity with Eutelsat Group – the world’s first GEO-LEO integrated global satellite operator.

As a leader in satellite communications, we provide global connectivity solutions - connecting businesses, communities, and governments around the world. We can connect you at on land, at sea and in the air. We also deliver broadcast television channels and packages, transmitting vital news reports around the world.

With Eutelsat Group You’ll Get To:

  • Pioneer the future of Space Technology
  • Bring connectivity to remote frontiers
  • Collaborate with customer-centric experts
  • Embrace cultural diversity in our global team

In a dynamic industry where passion drives our teams to make a difference to become the most trusted partner for global satellite connectivity, you will elevate your skills in a stretching, rewarding, and meaningful environment. At Eutelsat Group, we’re united by inclusion and diversity, striving for gender balance and social responsibility, on Earth and in Space.

Why Eutelsat Group?

  • Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: With colleagues from over 75 countries, we embrace our global DNA and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We are proud that one-third of our executive team and 60% of our board are represented by women.
  • Ways of Working That Drive Us : As "One Team," we work collaboratively towards shared goals, with customer-centricity, respect, and inclusivity as our guiding principles.
  • Sustainability at Our Core: At Eutelsat Group, sustainability is more than just a word; it’s woven into our strategy. We’re dedicated to balancing social, environmental, and economic growth — both on Earth and in space.
  • Work-Life Balance: We offer flexible schedules and hybrid/remote work options to help you balance your personal and professional life. At Eutelsat Group, we are committed to supporting your well‑being and ensuring you have the flexibility you need to succeed both at work and at home.

Ready to grow with us? Apply today and help us build a more inclusive, sustainable future in the world of satellite technology

Job Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic and skilled Accounting supervisor to join our team and play a critical role in the quality of the financial information of our subsidiaries located in Brazil . In this position, you’ll work closely with Accounting director and Tax director (located in Mexico) , contributing directly to our ongoing projects and initiatives. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact within an organization that values growth, teamwork, and professional development.

Who You Are:

Certified Public Accountant with strong technical accounting knowledge, 5+ years of experience with an international Enterprises or Audit within a Big 4 Firms, ability to work effectively with little supervision, focus on results and excellent ability to follow up, excellent communication and problem solving skills.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for providing truthful and timely monthly balance information for the subsidiaries located in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro).
  • Responsible for the revenue reporting in coordination with team of revenue controlling.
  • Review that revenue- cost with intercompany comply with percentage set up in the contracts.
  • Perform analysis of the P&L monthly variations against the previous month and the previous year and vs budget
  • Supervise the monthly reporting of balance and P&L (through One Stream)
  • Comply with controls to ensure that billing is complete and correct ensuring that the Brazilian tax rates were applied correctly.
  • Supervise the bank reconciliations, AR and AP ties vs trial balance their analysis by aging
  • Fixed assets accounting control in local currency and USD.
  • Analysis by aging of the provisions of accounts payable and outstanding invoices.
  • Analysis of the provisions of payroll
  • Design, implementation, maintenance, documentation and updating of accounting and internal control policies and procedures, integrating the requirements of other areas (Purchasing, Taxes, Financial Planning, Treasury, etc.)
  • Review the compliance of all tax returns timely based on a calendar and prepare a Summary.
  • Review the booking of tax provisions but also the payment of such taxes matches, if not ensure the booking of the adjustment.
  • Validate the reasonable of tax balances accounts.
  • Review that the bad debt reserve is proper computing and post in local ledger and report ledger.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience in accounting Brazilian and IFRS, internal control and taxes
  • Fluency in English and Spanish desirable.
  • Excel- advanced level

Where You’ll Work:

Hybrid mode 3 days at office and 2 days home office in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro)

The Eutelsat Group treats the protection of personal data submitted to it seriously. By submitting this application, you agree to the collection and retention of your personal data by the Eutelsat Group and acknowledge notice of, and understand the terms of Eutelsat’s Privacy Policy (as amended from time to time).

This role is a Eutelsat Group job opening; all of our open roles are posted on the current OneWeb and Eutelsat websites. Please note that when you are applying, your application may be seen by both teams.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT‑related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end‑user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi‑Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point‑of‑sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand‑held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point‑of‑sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen‑display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point‑of‑sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier‑1 support for Dining Service point‑of‑sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to Implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.
  • Anticipate and make recommendations regarding the replacement or updating of computer items.
  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT‑related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off‑prem/cloud‑based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and back‑ups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications but within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.
  • Ability to develop plans for resolving and implementing technical and operational problems.
  • Ability to work independently, to plan and prioritize activities that may span several locations on campus.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical problems due to complex system interfaces.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate in an office environment and in the field (various locations across all campuses of Howard University).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or closely related field and one year relevant experience;

or equivalent combination of a total of five (5) years combined relevant education and experience.

title: Software Engineer - L3 Support
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer – L3 Support to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑diving difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountableYou value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equality and Diversity

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid.
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management.
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions.
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions.
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption.
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday.
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements.
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements.
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies.
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases.
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality.
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root‑cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge‑base articles.
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes.
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed.
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen.
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution.
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices.

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements.
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution.
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail.
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing.
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience.
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training.
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

title: Software Engineer - Python - Cloud - graduate level
description:
Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Position

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.

The quality and stability of Ubuntu is critically important, as it is available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical and major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality‑oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability across a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions worldwide. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for a wide spectrum of users, from mission‑critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with them in mind.

Role Outline

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end‑system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on‑premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Rede Américas é a segunda maior rede hospitalar do Brasil, formada a partir da associação entre a Amil e a Dasa. Criada em 2025, tem como propósito oferecer uma jornada de saúde completa, ágil e humanizada.

description:
Fundada em 1986 por Paulo Martins da Luz (in memoriam), após sua brilhante trajetória profissional de 40 anos na multinacional TEXACO BRASIL S/A, onde atuou como diretor de Recursos Humanos, com o intuito de trazer para o mercado uma referência de terceirização de serviços e de mão de obra temporária, nascendo assim a PMLUZ CONSULTORIA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS LTDA especializada no fornecimento de mão de obra temporária e efetiva, fornecimento de treinamentos de equipes, administração de folhas de pagamento e gestão de pessoas.

O propósito de Paulo Martins estava em melhorar os processos de RH que eram bastante arcaicos e defasados na década de 80, com excelência nos processos de recrutamento e seleção, avaliações psicológicas para atividades de riscos, gestão administrativas e de pessoas, otimizando e diminuindo as burocracias e os riscos para seus clientes.

Em 2005, Alexandre Cerqueira Luz, formado em Administração com Pós-Graduação em Marketing e MBA em Recursos Humanos, assumiu a presidência da Pmluz Consultoria, trazendo uma visão moderna e bastante original, oferecendo um serviço mais personalizado para atender as particularidades de seus clientes.

Com grande experiência no mercado no segmento de Petróleo, Gás e Energia, foi fundada a PMLUZ ENERGY SERVIÇOS DE LOGISTICA LTDA, empresa especializada na prestação de serviços e cumprimento das normas criadas pela ANP 44/2013, elaborando uma metodologia atualizada, para flexibilizar e adaptar tais procedimentos, respeitando sempre a legislação, nossos valores e filosofia.

Hoje somos o GRUPO PMLUZ com prestação de serviços para contratos efetivos e temporários, gestão de pessoal, terceirização de folha de ponto e muitos outros serviços, atendendo os nossos clientes mantidos por mais de três décadas, em suas sedes e filiais em todo o Brasil.

E os nossos sonhos não param por aí, estamos sempre em busca de melhorias para facilitar nossos processos junto aos nossos, clientes, parceiros e colaboradores.

Cargo

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description:
Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil.

De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100).

Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova.

Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador

Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço.

É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão.

Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos:

O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar.

2-Técnico de Necropsia

O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil.

As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais.

As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias.

Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos.

O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso.

Atribuições

Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso.

5-Delegado de Polícia

O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres:

  • Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública;
  • Assegurar a observância da lei;
  • Defender as instituições públicas;
  • Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais;
  • Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais;
  • Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital.

Etapas do concurso

A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital.

O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social.

Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio

O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo deAuxiliar de Necropsia daPolícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já paraTécnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59.

OInspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38.

A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95.

Detalhes do concurso

  • Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ)
  • Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior

Identificar os desvios e sugerir ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, mantendo o Sistema de Gestão da Manutenção atualizado com as informações decorrentes da execução do serviço, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade operacional dos ativos.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Job Purpose

To provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure the efficient operation of the office and assists with the coordination of program activities. The incumbent facilitates communication between teams ensuring that projects run smoothly and meet organizational goals. The incumbent serves as a liaison between administrative program staff and the rest of the university stakeholders in meeting the operational and logistical needs of the department. This position will report to the Associate Dean of Research Graduate Programs.

Supervisory Authority

Has responsibility or authority which is limited to the direction of student workers.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts may include senior administrators, faculty, students, and staff. External contacts may include vendors, consultants, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide comprehensive administrative and program support to ensure efficient office operations, including managing, and making travel arrangements for senior staff.
  • Maintain filing systems, operate and maintain office equipment, and coordinate repairs and maintenance.
  • Answer and direct phone calls, respond to digital correspondence, and greet visitors.
  • Coordinate logistics for meetings and events, including room setup, catering, and reservations.
  • Arrange meetings, schedule conferences, as directed by supervisor; notifies attendees or participants in logistics.

Manage the College of Arts and Sciences travel inbox, responding to inquiries related to travel and reimbursements while ensuring the timely processing of travel and expense reimbursements. Develop, maintain, and communicate clear policies and procedures related to university travel and expense reimbursement.
  • Maintain filing systems, operate and maintain office equipment, and coordinate repairs and maintenance.
  • Answer and direct phone calls, respond to digital correspondence, and greet visitors.

This role supports faculty by monitoring expenditures, reconciling accounts, and providing guidance on allowable costs, while coordinating with the Provost Office, and Sponsored Programs to ensure timely and accurate processing of transactions.

description:
O Oficial de Manutenção Especializada II é responsável por realizar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em sistemas e equipamentos eletromecânicos complexos, assegurando a operação eficiente e segura das instalações. Este profissional atua na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos, realizando ajustes e reparos especializados para garantir a continuidade das operações.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas eletromecânicos, como motores, bombas, geradores, e sistemas automatizados, conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver falhas em equipamentos eletromecânicos, substituindo componentes danificados e realizando ajustes necessários para garantir o funcionamento adequado.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos e mecânicos, manuais técnicos e diagramas para realizar as manutenções e reparos de acordo com as especificações.
  • Realizar testes e medições em sistemas e equipamentos para verificar a eficiência e segurança operacional, utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos apropriados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de manutenção preditiva, monitorando o desempenho dos equipamentos e identificando possíveis falhas antes que se tornem problemas críticos.
  • Manter registros detalhados das atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo os materiais utilizados, problemas identificados e soluções aplicadas.
  • Seguir as normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados e assegurando um ambiente de trabalho seguro.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de manutenção e engenheiros para garantir a integração e eficiência dos sistemas eletromecânicos com outros componentes das instalações.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter atualizado com as novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.

Requisitos

  • Ensino técnico completo em Eletromecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção eletromecânica ou áreas similares, com conhecimento avançado em sistemas e equipamentos eletromecânicos.
  • Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de esquemas elétricos e mecânicos, manuais técnicos e diagramas.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis à manutenção de sistemas eletromecânicos.
  • Certificações e cursos de especialização em manutenção eletromecânica (desejável).

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament‑wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk‑informed decision‑making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament‑wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non‑competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

Your profile

Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: SUPERVISOR DE LIMPEZA - CENTRO/RJ Rio de Janeiro - RJ Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Sobre a Vaga: Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Limpeza dinâmico e proativo para liderar nossas equipes operacionais. Nesta função, você será o elo fundamental entre a estratégia da empresa e a execução impecável no cliente. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Supervisionar e orientar as equipes de limpeza e conservação em diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos cronogramas de trabalho e os padrões de qualidade GSS.
  • Realizar a gestão de insumos, controlando a utilização de materiais e equipamentos.
  • Treinar e desenvolver os colaboradores, focando em técnicas eficientes e segurança do trabalho.
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e manter o contato direto com os clientes para garantir a satisfação total com os serviços prestados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários para otimizar a performance da equipe.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha "Segurança Sem Preconceito", reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

Main responsibilities

Para dar continuidade ao preenchimento da vaga no Gupy para a GSS Segurança e Serviços , aqui está uma estrutura detalhada de responsabilidades e requisitos.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar, escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).
  • Segurança do Trabalho: Fiscalizar o uso obrigatório de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e garantir que todas as normas de segurança (NRs) sejam respeitadas no ambiente de trabalho.
  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

Requirements and skills

O que é essencial (Requisitos):

  • Ensino Médio completo (Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Gestão de Facilities, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de supervisão ou liderança operacional no segmento de limpeza e conservação.
  • Conhecimento técnico avançado em produtos químicos (diluição, PH, superfícies) e operação de máquinas de limpeza industrial.
  • Domínio básico/intermediário do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel para controle de estoque e escalas).
  • Possuir CNH ativa (categoria B ou superior) e disponibilidade para deslocamento entre diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Perfil proativo, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

O que será um diferencial (Desejável):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de Segurança Patrimonial ou Terceirização de Serviços de Grande Porte.
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (como NR-35 para trabalho em altura ou NR-06 para EPIs).
  • Residir na região ou ter fácil acesso aos principais eixos de atendimento da empresa.

  • Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;

  • Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;
  • Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;
  • No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;
  • Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia;
  • Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência anterior em rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;
  • Excel intermediário ou avançado;
  • Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;
  • Facilidade de comunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas;
  • Conhecimento em Sienge;
  • Experiência em obras com múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;
  • Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;
  • Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira.

Outras informações:

title: Analista de Marketing Direto
description:
1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE MARKETING DIRETO EM MSF-BRASIL?

Você irá desenvolver, implementar e analisar ações de marketing direto, com ênfase em canais offline como malas diretas e cartas de relacionamento, visando fortalecer o vínculo com a base de pessoas doadoras, ampliar a captação de recursos e potencializar o engajamento e a retenção.

Além disso, irá atuar com inovação nas abordagens, otimizando as ações de relacionamento e maximização dos resultados, acompanhando o desempenho das campanhas, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e novos formatos. Além disso, atuar para que todas as ações e materiais de marketing direto reflitam práticas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão, utilizando linguagem acolhedora, acessível e representativa, considerando diferentes perfis da base de pessoas doadoras.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Contribuir para a sustentabilidade e o crescimento da rentabilidade do canal offline, buscando a máxima de resultados e eficiência em custos de produção e logística postal;
  • Evoluir o modelo de marketing direto offline, incorporando análises mais profundas de dados e maior integração com estratégias de canais digitais;
  • Contribuir para uma cultura de análise e otimização contínua, orientando as ações baseadas em dados e subsidiando decisões.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Atividades de Marketing e Relacionamento

  • Planejar, implementar e otimizar campanhas de marketing direto offline (malas, cartas e materiais impressos), contribuindo com a Coordenação desde a construção até a mensuração dos resultados;
  • Executar segmentações e propor novos critérios e testes A/B, documentando aprendizados, hipóteses, resultados e fluxos;
  • Supervisionar o fluxo de produção com pessoas fornecedoras internas e externas de mala direta e materiais institucionais, assegurando prazos, qualidade e respeitando orçamento e custos finais de acordo com a verba disponível;
  • Acompanhar e realizar análise de resultados de campanhas, elaborando relatórios e propondo melhorias com base em métricas, como taxa de resposta, custo por aquisição, valor médio de doação e taxa de retenção;
  • Contribuir para que as peças, textos e segmentações adotem linguagem inclusiva, evitando vieses ou estereótipos e assegurando que diferentes perfis de pessoas doadoras se sintam respeitados e representados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e benchmarks de mercado em marketing direto e relacionamento com pessoas doadoras, aplicando boas práticas e sugerindo melhorias;
  • Considerar acessibilidade e inclusão nas propostas e revisões de materiais impressos e digitais, identificando ajustes que tornem a comunicação mais clara e inclusiva;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o planejamento anual de marketing direto, identificando oportunidades de inovação, otimização de processos e aumento de eficiência;
  • Contribuir para a integração das ações de marketing direto com campanhas digitais, fortalecendo a jornada multicanal da pessoa doadora;
  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, trabalhando em ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as demais células do Hub, assegurando coesão das estratégias de relacionamento e desenvolvimento, de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos de cada área;

Compromissos Institucionais – MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho ético, equitativo e inclusivo, pautado pela escuta ativa, pelo respeito e pela colaboração;
  • Conhecer e aplicar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização no exercício de suas atividades, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios institucionais;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas e equipes de forma proativa, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do trabalho transversal e para a melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Contribuir, dentro de suas atribuições, para a implementação dos objetivos definidos nos planejamentos estratégico e operacional, com responsabilidade sobre suas entregas e atenção à qualidade do trabalho;
  • Adotar práticas que valorizem a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão, respeitando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Requisitos:

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Graduação completa em Marketing e áreas afins
  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes/pessoas doadoras ou comunicação (campanhas offline)
  • Proficiência intermediária em Inglês
  • Conhecimentos de Pacote office e CRM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de BI, relatórios de performance e análise de resultados
  • Conhecimentos de diversidade, equidade e inclusão em campanhas

5. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

Você precisará demonstrar pensamento analítico para interpretar dados e apoiar a tomada de decisões nas ações de marketing direto. Será essencial manter planejamento e organização para gerenciar atividades, prazos e entregas com qualidade. A iniciativa e a inovação serão importantes para propor melhorias e ajustes nos processos, assim como a capacidade de negociação para atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas e fornecedores, buscando soluções alinhadas aos objetivos de MSF.

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA:

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, iremos priorizar a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como parte de grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans e PcD.

Venha fazer parte da equipe de Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno sobre sua participação.

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time ever, it will be hosted in South America in Brazil. This is your chance to be part of a workforce creating an unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position

The Procurement Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 will support the implementation of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, ensuring organization-wide compliance through ongoing employee training and adherence checks. Responsibilities include creating Purchase Orders (POs) in SAP, supporting RFI/RFP processes, driving inter‑departmental alignment, and managing the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database to deliver cost efficiency and compliance across the FIFA procurement landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement the FIFA27 Procurement Policy and procedures across the organization. Act as gatekeeper of the process at the relevant stages.
  • Train employees on an on-going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Maintain the SAP cost contract database, including entering and maintaining contract data and creation of Purchase Orders (POs).
  • Manage (solve or forward) queries raised to the FIFA27 Procurement team mailbox.
  • Support project leaders in all procurement matters, including setting up RFIs and RFPs.
  • Create spend reports for management as requested.
  • Conduct administrative activities of the procurement team.

Your Profile

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.
  • Minimum 1 year experience in a similar role.
  • Good SAP MM knowledge is an asset.
  • Knowledge of DocuSign is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow is an asset.
  • High standard of attention to detail.
  • Practical mindset and solution oriented.
  • Capable of working in an environment of rapid change, tight deadlines and high scrutiny.
  • Understands the application of governance and compliance.
  • Understands key contract elements and contractual language.
  • Tolerance to repetitive work.
  • Organized, able to prioritize workloads.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Mechanical CADD Technician
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Junior level, Mechanical Designer Technician to join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office. As part of the Mechanical Group, the Mechanical Engineer Designer will have experience with solid bulk conveyance systems, hydraulic modelling and design of liquid bulk transmission systems, as well as utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems. Experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals are a plus.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • To prepare a variety of designs from Agri bulk material, and mining bulk in Port Terminals or industrial plants
  • To prepare a variety of designs in waterfront facilities such as marinas, container terminals, marine oil terminals and pump stations and utilities (firefighting / water / sewer / stormwater) systems projects
  • To perform hydraulic modelling and analysis of liquid bulk transmission systems and utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems
  • Preparing design documents (plans and specifications) with an emphasis on utility service design
  • To design other projects such as piping to support in other projects such as liquid bulk terminal and utilities which will include piping design using either Plant 3D or similar software
  • To generate proposals and develop fee estimates for PS&E packages
  • To assist with condition assessment inspections for terminals equipment and utilities infrastructure

Other Duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (Desirable)
  • 2-6 years of experience in mechanical design related to bulk material handling
    • Experience in 3D piping design required
    • Plant 3D or equivalent (PDMS, PDS, etc.) experience required
  • Design experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals is a plus
  • General understanding of process design, process flow diagram development, and piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) development
  • Acknowledgement in developing equipment specification, calculation, data sheets, drawings reviews and other documents related to mechanical design
  • Some planning and task management skills
  • Complete piping and pipelines stress analysis using CAESAR is a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish is an advantage
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working Conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions® serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. Moffatt & Nichol is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Federal Contractor desiring priority referrals of all protected veterans for job openings.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations
description:
Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience
  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.
Skills & Competencies
  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The position

Reporting to both the Head of Government and Host City Management and Manager of Government and Host City Management, the Visa & Immigration Manager will serve as the primary liaison between the FIFA 2027 team, an external immigration service provider, and government authorities involved in visa and immigration processes.   • Project and event management experience is considered an advantage.
  • Practical knowledge of global mobility or international administrative processes is beneficial.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

Senior Graphic Designer

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will lead the creative development and localisation of Brand Graphic assets ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football. Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Solid experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Own, drive and oversee creative process and localisation across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Inline with Brand Guidelines and central Brand direction, direct and produce creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.

Project Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead junior designer and external creative partners to deliver cohesive, high-impact work across formats and platforms.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative outputs with business and brand objectives.
  • Brief, manage, and evaluate external agencies, production partners, ensuring creative alignment and production quality.

Brand Guardianship & Design Systems

  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS -ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Important : Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in senior graphic or art direction roles within agency, sports events or Entertainment.

Competencies and Personality

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design solid experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collateral
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands-on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Rigor

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.

Você é uma pessoa motivada, com vontade de crescer e construir uma carreira sólida? Busca um ambiente onde seu trabalho é valorizado e seu desenvolvimento profissional é uma prioridade? Então, temos a oportunidade perfeita para você!

Se você está pronto para assumir um papel essencial, onde seu trabalho será valorizado e terá um impacto positivo na segurança e tranquilidade de muitos, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe de vigilantes. Aqui, seu crescimento profissional é nossa prioridade.

Não perca a chance de integrar uma equipe dedicada e crescer em um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial. Junte-se a nós e comece uma jornada de sucesso como vigilante!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável por garantir a integridade física do patrimônio e das pessoas, além de atuar como ponto de apoio na comunicação da unidade.

  • Monitoramento: Acompanhar sistemas de CFTV (Circuito Fechado de Televisão) e alarmes, agindo prontamente em caso de alerta.
  • Passagem de Posto: Realizar a troca de turno verificando o estado de equipamentos (rádios, lanternas, chaves) e lendo as últimas ocorrências.

  • Comunicação via Rádio: Utilizar códigos de comunicação (Código Q) de forma profissional e concisa.

  • Informática Básica: Conhecimento para preenchimento de relatórios digitais e operação de sistemas de monitoramento/telefonia.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Postura vigilante, pontualidade, discrição e capacidade de manter a calma em situações de pressão.
  • Verificação de Perímetro: Conferir o fechamento de portões, janelas e o funcionamento de cercas elétricas ou sensores de presença.

Job Description

The position

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Senior Competition Manager, the Competition Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team. Working closely with and under the guidance of the FIFA Competition Management project team, the role is responsible for delivering the highest standards of competition, tournament and match operations in Brazil before and during the FWWC27, as well as for FIFA test events and other relevant tournaments and events.

  • Ensure that competition area and venue readiness are implemented in line with FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines, under the guidance of FIFA Competition Management and the Senior Competition Operations Manager.
